claims.text: Spec 041's scholarly product is the site × local-label period mapping artifact.
claims.boundary: Scope claim for the whole spec. The act builds cells (label mappings) and reports coverage; it performs no inscription-level join, computes no repertoire quantity, and states no G1 consequence. Placement of inscriptions is a future consumer's act under its own freeze. It does not govern the key (C02), the evidence standard (C05-C08), or the gates (C09), which are stated separately. Carried from the draft head, verbatim in substance: The act also produces the mapping's coverage report; the mapping and its coverage report are the act's only products. Recovery restatement at 0.7-draft: the previous head ('Spec 041 produces exactly one scholarly artifact — the site × local-label period mapping — and its coverage report.') was restated to a single proposition; its remaining substance stands in this boundary.
alternatives: The act could also place the population's inscriptions and report the placed population as a convenience product.
falsification_tests: Any Spec 041 product containing a repertoire quantity, a G1 statement, or per-inscription period assignments defeats this claim.

claims.text: A MAPPED cell rests on a published determination verified to the carried DD-039-3 bar.
claims.boundary: The grounding claim (spec sections 3, 5.3, 7.1). Published means the DD-039-3 venue-and-locator test; verified means read in the publication's own text or in a published restatement quoting it with pagination. The cell carries citation, locator, mapping rule, and verification mode. It does not govern disagreement between determinations (C07) or their absence (C08). Carried from the draft head, verbatim in substance: The determination assigns the cell's local label exactly one coarse period, and the cell carries its citation, locator, mapping rule, and verification mode. Recovery restatement at 0.7-draft: the previous head ('A cell is MAPPED only when a published determination verified to the carried DD-039-3 bar assigns its local label exactly one coarse period.') was restated to a single proposition; its remaining substance stands in this boundary.

falsification_tests: A MAPPED cell whose citation lacks a locator, whose venue fails the DD-039-3 test, or whose determination does not read as recorded at the locator defeats this claim.
